From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Alicia Park <apark@cloudscale.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly capacity pulse — CloudScale pilot & deal cadence

Team — looping you in for this week's capacity pulse tied to the CloudScale pilot (DEAL-2349). Key facts up front:
- Sales update: Jordan, CloudScale is targeting a Jan pilot with an expected 10k monthly queries, spiking to 40k/day during evaluation windows.
- Finance ask: we need cost/runway options for a 3-month pilot + optional reserved capacity.
- Infra constraints: Diego, we have limited dedicated slots in Jan due to node maintenance week of 1/17.

Please see attached pipeline_snapshot_20261210.csv for the current commit profile (Alicia — thanks for the visibility). Requests:
1) Jordan — confirm the exact concurrency/seq length distribution we should model (short chat vs long generation).
2) Laura — can you run a quick cost delta for burst-only vs 1-month reserved + burst?
3) Diego — can you validate whether we can allocate 2x r4-16 slots for 3 weeks in Jan, or propose fallback (quantized on-host)?

I added the draft capacity_matrix_draft_v2.pdf for a quick read; don't worry about numbers being final — want directional tradeoffs by Monday. If Alicia (CloudScale) has procurement windows or PO timing, please call it out.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
--

- CloudScale plan: 2 evaluation windows (7-day each) during pilot; expected p95 request size ~220 tokens, median ~60 tokens. Burst concurrency estimate: ~120 concurrent requests during peak windows.
- Procurement timing: they want a one-page MOU before the pilot and will try to issue a PO within 30 days after pilot start if metrics look good.

Attached the latest product brief I shared with Alicia. For modeling, treat the evaluation windows as worst-case scenarios for cost.

Thanks Priya — quick financial read attached (capacity_matrix_costs_v1.xlsx). High-level:
- Burst-only: estimated cloud & token spend ~$18k for a 4-week pilot (assumes optimization + caching).
- 1-month reserved (small pool) + burst: upfront commitment increases cost by ~12% but reduces per-token by ~22% during peak windows; runway risk reduced if they convert.
- Credit/discount ask: for pilot upsell probability, recommend we offer a pilot discount (10%) if they sign a 12-month reserved commitment within 45 days post-pilot.

Questions for infra: can we guarantee the 2x r4-16 slots during both evaluation windows if they land on the 1/10 and 1/24 windows? If not, need to propose alternative permutations (quantized + burst, or staggered evaluation).

Laura
Sr. Manager, Revenue Finance

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 17:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly capacity pulse — CloudScale pilot & deal cadence

Quick infra read — short answer: we can support the pilot but with caveats. Details:
- Jan maintenance window (1/17-1/20) reduces available dedicated r4-16 slots by ~30%. If evaluation windows overlap maintenance, we cannot promise contiguous reserved slots.
- Proposed fallback 1: provide 1x r4-16 dedicated + burst capacity spun from spare general pool; configure aggressive KV-prefix caching for predictable prefixes to cut token compute by ~18% during steady-state.
- Proposed fallback 2: offer quantized 4-bit model variant for evaluation windows — cost drops materially but we'd want a quality checkpoint in the first day of the pilot.

Operational asks:
- If sales wants reserved slots guaranteed, need a signed MOU by Dec 20 to schedule capacity and move hardware maintenance out-of-phase.
- We can prepare a minimal runbook for rapid scaling during eval windows, but need a confirmed contact at CloudScale (Alicia) for scale triggers.

Diego
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
